title: Truncated patch reply reported as no_edit
bug_report:
Seen when running the pipeline with a reasoning model (one that spends many tokens on hidden reasoning before answering). The patch stage fails and the pipeline records the failure reason `no_edit`, which suggests the model produced no usable SEARCH/REPLACE block. Looking at the provider response and the call log: the patch request actually returned an EMPTY reply with finish_reason 'length', and the call log shows tokens_out equal to the output cap (1024). So the real cause was that the reply was cut off at the output-token cap, but nothing in the pipeline says so; operators wasted time prompt-engineering. Expected: a clear truncation reason instead of `no_edit`, and the output-token cap should not be a hard-coded value.

Observed in the call log (runs/llm_calls.jsonl) and the stored failure reason.

injections.old:
if resp.finish_reason == "length" and not (resp.content or "").strip():
        raise OutputTruncated("patch reply truncated at the output-token cap with no content")
llm_max_output_tokens: int = 4096  # reasoning models spend part of this on hidden reasoning
